_conforms_to.spec: validates against harness/schemas/RCA.json. Diagnostic substrate output for the firmware update scenario.

evidence.finding: Intel E810 firmware 4.40 matches KB 8731; fixed in 4.50+.

candidate_classifications.rationale: Drift persists after the KMM driver swap, isolating the root cause to NIC firmware. Intel KB 8731 confirms a PHC hardware-timestamp queue bug at firmware 4.40 fixed in 4.50+. Remediation path is Metal3 HostFirmwareComponents apply via BMC Redfish UpdateService. The node reboots during firmware activation, so the dispatcher emits a TMF921 companion intent to the partner SMO to pre-handover cells during the maintenance window.
